title: Method C L-Panel Benchmark Setup and Adaptive Remeshing Execution
review_directive: Set up and execute the 500 mm mixed-mode L-panel benchmark per HND-METHOD-C-MODE2-LPANEL-001/005: 500 mm L-shaped panel (500 mm wide top, 500 mm tall left, 250 mm bottom width, 250 mm right-leg height, notch at inner corner), E = 25.84 GPa, nu = 0.18, l0 = 3.125 mm, Gc = 9.5e-5 kN/mm, thickness 100 mm, bottom edge fixed, upward displacement at 30 mm from right edge. Use validated transfer machinery (*STATIC 1.0, 1.0, 1.0E-08, 1.0; *NODE OUTPUT U; nearest-neighbour damage/history transfer; global d_max gate). Refinement corridor follows Winkler path. Completion: crack path matching Winkler path or RF drop below 5% of peak. Commit/push each cycle. Local PC only, 0 PBS, cumulative 73 preserved, frozen UEL CE8D5EDC untouched, HPC job 1424916 untouched, master goal OPEN.
notes: Completed L-panel setup, Cycle 0 coarse qualification, and Adaptive Cycles 1 to 3 with state transfer and single-increment re-equilibration card. Cycles 1 and 2 passed transfer gates (-0.0151% and -2.8135%). In Cycle 3, discovered and verified that concentrated point-load displacement without a steel collar creates an unphysical singular puncture at (470, 250) (d -> 0.9706 while corner stayed at 0.2083), causing a -62.74% force collapse. Proposing steel collar phase-field constraint (*BOUNDARY N_LOAD_COLLAR, 3, 3, 0.0) per Winkler (2001) / Miehe (2010) to guide authentic curved crack growth. Staged and ready for Independent Structured Review under HND-METHOD-C-MODE2-LPANEL-006.
